combo_label: The Garage × At the Funfair × Codes & Ciphers

entries.clue: Ground steel with a flat back, driven by a mallet to clear a mortise
Soft yellow skin wrung out to dry the bodywork without a streak
Greek who told of a message tattooed on a shaved scalp
Make out an illegible scrawl, or read a message in code
Travelling collection of wild beasts, a great draw at Victorian fairs
Covered walk of shops, or the seafront hall full of coin machines
Hidden message spelled by the first letter of each line
One sent into another country to steal its secrets
Hand whose lines are read for a future in the little curtained tent
Iron bedded in a sole, set fine to take a whisper off a door edge
Metal disc fed into an amusement machine in place of a coin
Violet-dyed spirit bought for camping stoves and shifting a stain
